name: MetalHatsCats CBT Toolkit
relationship: public source corpus related to CBT Cards
publication_policy: CBT Cards publishes a standalone page from this corpus only when the stable source record ID is explicitly listed as reviewed_for_publication and published in the CBT Cards review overlay. Any unlisted source record defaults to unreviewed and source_only. Editorial publication review is not clinical validation or evidence of efficacy.
quality_notes: The source taxonomy distinguishes card, metaphor, and protocol records but does not encode CBT Cards-specific clinical-review or publication status.
The corpus contains CBT-adjacent techniques and labels in addition to core CBT concepts; a record should not be treated as clinical guidance solely because it appears in this dataset.
Protocol records remain source-only unless explicitly added to the CBT Cards review overlay after separate editorial and safety review.
Source records protocol-1 and protocol-8 share the title Burnout Recovery Protocol; stable source IDs, not titles, are authoritative.
